explanation: What happens on each 2-second chat check while nothing new has been written. Leaves out what happens when something did change: then the whole transcript is sent and read again, as today.

before.title: Today
items: Machine re-reads and checks the whole saved transcript
Whole transcript sent to the app server
App server reads through all of it again
App server keeps the text forever

after.title: After
items: Machine looks at the file's size only
App server says which version it already has
App server reuses what it already worked out
Dropped after 10 minutes nobody is looking
